mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crawl_post ( post_key, post_url, post_title, status, created_at, updated_at, last_crawled_at ) VALUES ( #{post.postKey}, #{post.postUrl}, #{post.postTitle}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE post_title = COALESCE(VALUES(post_title), post_title), last_crawled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT post_key, post_url, post_title, published_at, drama_query, normalized_query, tmdb_id, content_hash, status, error_code, error_message FROM crawl_post WHERE status = #{discoveredStatus} OR (#{retryFailed} = TRUE AND status = #{failedStatus}) ORDER BY created_at, post_url
mapper.update: UPDATE crawl_post SET drama_query = #{post.dramaQuery}, normalized_query = #{post.normalizedQuery}, content_hash = #{post.contentHash}, status = #{status}, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE post_key = #{post.postKey}

UPDATE crawl_post SET status = #{status}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE post_key = #{postKey}
